entry.title: An Nvidia insider-turned-VC on why robotics hasn’t hit its ChatGPT moment, yet
entry.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundation model, is about to have […]

entry.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
entry.summary: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.

entry.title: Porsche’s electric Macan Turbo is an automotive existential crisis
entry.summary: The 2026 Porsche Macan Turbo EV is a two-row crossover with 630 horsepower and a 100-kilowatt-hour battery.

entry.title: Mark Wahlberg wants to take on the longevity-startup crowd with an affordable gym concept
entry.summary: Mark Wahlberg, who once sank money into a gym chain that got kicked off the NYSE, is now building his own, and he promises you’ll get a cold plunge, a blood panel and a protein muffin without needing a trust fund.

entry.title: Ember’s new temperature-controlled mug makes my nightly tea ritual even better
entry.summary: The biggest change about Ember's new mug is that you no longer have to open the app to adjust your drink’s temperature.

entry.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
entry.summary: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.

entry.title: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
entry.summary: The composition of Anthropic’s workforce and the type of work getting done have changed significantly in the past year.

entry.title: TikTok says it’s restored ‘Musk’ documentary advertising account
entry.summary: A four-hour documentary about Elon Musk continues to meet resistance from social media platforms.

entry.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
entry.summary: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.

entry.title: TechCrunch Mobility: Rivian’s next act
entry.summary: Welcome back to TechCrunch Mobility, your hub for the future of transportation and now, more than ever, the role AI is playing in it.

entry.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
entry.summary: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.

entry.title: Everyone’s watching the Elizabeth Holmes documentary ‘You Can See Everything’
entry.summary: "You Can See Everything" is having the second biggest opening weekend ever for a documentary film.

entry.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
entry.summary: The company offered some broad-strokes ideas for how this money might actually be used, such as “large donations to traditional nonprofits or direct distributions to specific populations.”

entry.title: No agenda, no rush, no leaving San Francisco: Benchmark’s partners on investing in a frenzied market
entry.summary: Benchmark may have grown its funds and swapped out some partners, but onstage the five who are left sounded like friends who just happen to be running one of the Valley’s most storied firms

entry.title: Khosla Ventures doubles down on Even Healthcare to challenge India’s hospital economics
entry.summary: Even Healthcare reaches a $300 million valuation in a Khosla Ventures-led round as it plans to expand its hospital network in India.

entry.title: Musk pledges to give ‘every kid in America’ one of his SpaceX shares
entry.summary: Musk's post came just a few hours after Anthropic promised to put 5% of its shares into a new "public benefit fund," which it intends to use to make "large donations to traditional nonprofits or direct distributions to specific populations" after its upcoming IPO.

entry.title: Apple updates guidelines to ban nudify apps masquerading as regular apps to pass review
entry.summary: The company updated its guidelines with strong language around AI and user-generated content, and how app developers should include enough preventative measures to moderate objectionable or offensive content.

entry.title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
entry.summary: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.

entry.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
entry.summary: Fed up with ads, tracking and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

entry.title: Amazon to fund 12 small nuclear reactors at former Indiana coal plant
entry.summary: Amazon and X-energy have inked another deal to deploy nuclear power to the grid. This one will generate nearly 1 gigawatt of electricity.
